bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg=deploy-postgres-1
test "$(docker inspect "$pg" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
sql="SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_post_receipts r JOIN videobot_listings l ON l.listing_id=r.listing_id WHERE r.listing_id='starsrepair4701_20261123' AND r.status='sent' AND r.paid_message_id>4701 AND array_length(r.free_message_ids,1)=2 AND l.price_stars=10 AND l.status='published' AND l.paid_video_file_id IS NOT NULL AND l.rights_verified=TRUE AND l.adult_consent_verified=TRUE)=1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM videobot_post_receipts WHERE paid_message_id IN (4691,4701) AND status='sent')=2 THEN 'STARS_NATIVE_NEW_POST_READBACK_PASS' ELSE 'STARS_NATIVE_NEW_POST_READBACK_FAIL' END;"
result="$(docker exec -e "SQL=$sql" "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -At -c "$SQL"')"
echo "$result"
test "$result" = STARS_NATIVE_NEW_POST_READBACK_PASS || exit 72
sql2="SELECT r.paid_message_id,array_to_string(r.free_message_ids,','),r.status,l.price_stars FROM videobot_post_receipts r JOIN videobot_listings l ON l.listing_id=r.listing_id WHERE r.listing_id='starsrepair4701_20261123';"
docker exec -e "SQL=$sql2" "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -At -F "|" -c "$SQL"'
